basis: NN’s March 10, 2022 release establishes that Q4 2021 consolidated GAAP net sales were $110,379,000, down 7.27% from $119,028,000 in Q4 2020 and below the $113,076,600 cutoff. Both amounts appear in the same three-month table, with Life Sciences treated as discontinued operations. The earliest disclosure date remains unresolved. NN announced a public deck for September 14, 2021, and a September 16 listing attributes that deck to NN, but I could not verify its contents. The upper_bound field records the verified March actual.

coverage.detail: August 5 Q2 release reported $123.2 million of Q2 net sales. It gave no numeric Q4 consolidated sales range.

Slide 16 expected second-half sales broadly consistent with the first half, subject to normal Q4 seasonality. NN did not quantify that adjustment or give a Q4 ceiling. The 3%–7% growth range on slide 15 applied to second-half Power Solutions demand.
NN’s Q2 event page links to this Chorus Call replay. The host confirms August 6, 2021 at 9 a.m. EDT and marks the presentation expired.

A third-party transcript corroborates management’s second-half seasonality discussion and continued suspension of formal revenue guidance. The Q&A discussion of potentially losing three to four shift days supplies no dollar or percentage ceiling for Q4 sales.

NN’s September 1 notice distinguishes the invitation-only investor meetings from the presentation scheduled for public posting before the September 14 market open. It gives no Q4 sales figure and links to the corporate homepage for the presentation.

The specific 2021 host URL identified in NN’s notice was inaccessible. The host’s current roster at https://www.lakestreetcapitalmarkets.com/presenting-companies covers September 2026. The historical lookup at https://web.archive.org/web/20210914000000/https://www.lakestreetcapitalmarkets.com/big5conference also returned no readable page.

The issuer’s IR archive returned 2026 presentations at this URL. The September 2021 lookup at https://web.archive.org/web/20210915000000/https://investors.nninc.com/news-events/presentations and the archive availability query at https://archive.org/wayback/available?url=investors.nninc.com%2Fnews-events%2Fpresentations&timestamp=20210915 were inaccessible.

The September 16 slideshow page attributes the deck to NN. Its readable text contains no slides or financial figures. The article endpoint at https://seekingalpha.com/api/v3/articles/4455672 was also inaccessible. The listing establishes neither the deck’s contents nor its original posting time.

The supplied 8-K inventory contains no September conference exhibit. A targeted web search of NN’s EDGAR exhibits found no matching 2021 deck. The date-filtered SEC search endpoint was inaccessible, so it did not independently establish completeness.
November 4 Q3 release reported $117.2 million of Q3 net sales, up 3.1%. It discussed semiconductor shortages without quantifying Q4 consolidated sales.

Slides 13–15 described soft Q4 Mobile Solutions demand, approximately 3% year-over-year Q4 demand growth for Power Solutions, and specific cash-flow items. None gives a numeric upper bound for consolidated Q4 revenue.
NN’s Q3 event page links to this Chorus Call replay. The host confirms November 5, 2021 at 9 a.m. EDT and marks the presentation expired.

The third-party transcript records management saying formal revenue guidance remained suspended. The 17.8% Q4 decline discussed on the call was an IHS forecast for global vehicle production units. It cannot establish NN’s consolidated sales decline.

NN’s intervening release archive identifies two February 24 announcements. One concerned closure of the Taunton facility within Power Solutions. The other scheduled the March 10 earnings release. Neither disclosed preliminary Q4 consolidated sales.
The March 4 exhibit amended 2022–2023 leverage covenants and discussed expected 2022 profitability. It supplied no Q4 2021 revenue estimate.

The March 10 release reports net sales of 110,379 and 119,028 in thousands of dollars for the three months ended December 31, 2021 and 2020. Its reconciliation independently labels those same quarterly amounts consolidated GAAP net sales.

publication_date_evidence: NN’s IR page timestamps the actual-results release March 10, 2022 at 4:30 p.m. EST. SEC Exhibit 99.1 carries the same March 10 dateline. The earnings call followed March 11. The unresolved September deck prevents assigning March 10 as the onset date.
